editorial.blurb: This unmarked Korean gem delivers authentic, intensely flavored dishes like spicy buldak and seafood pancake in a cozy, low-lit space pulsing with K-pop energy.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right when they open at 5pm to beat the crowds, or get bar seating for a front-row view of the grill action—and bring cash or Zelle, as card options are limited.
